properties.description: Post-load validation. A single Stored Procedure activity, because the checks themselves live in SQL -- row-count reconciliation, referential integrity, header-versus-lines financial reconciliation, warehouse domain assertions and pipeline-lag freshness. Keeping them there rather than as a dozen ADF activities means the local runner in etl/ executes exactly the same checks, and that adding a check is an INSERT into etl.etl_validation_rule rather than a pipeline redeployment.

activities.name: ValidateSalesData
activities.description: Runs every post-load check and writes each result to etl.etl_validation_log. Source row counts default to the values the extract stage recorded in etl.etl_run_entity, so the source is counted once, during extraction, rather than being re-queried here -- by which point the answer could legitimately have changed.
